clean_body: | | | | Boysko Bulletin: Historic Win - Paid Family and Medical Leave for Virginians! Dear Peter, I was thrilled to stand with my colleague Delegate Sewell and Governor Spanberger to celebrate the signing of our legislation, my bill , and Delegate Briana Sewell’s . With benefits set to begin in 2028, Virginia is the 14th state plus the District of Columbia, notably the first in the South, to establish a Paid Family and Medical Leave program, expanding access to more than 3.5 million Virginians who currently lack access to paid leave. I’ve been working on this policy as the Senate’s Chief Patron for the past 8 legislative sessions to get it right for Virginia because in households all over Virginia, families face medical emergencies and welcome new children. For those lucky enough to have paid family and medical leave through their employer—or enough personal savings to get by during unpaid time off—serious health events, caring for a parent at the end of their lives, or the arrival of a new baby can be manageable and meaningful, with the focus on healing and bonding. But for most Virginians, these life events come with an impossible choice: care for a loved one, recover from a medical crisis, bond with a newborn—or keep working to afford rent, groceries, utilities, and other basic needs. I draw from my own experience when my husband and I welcomed our second child delivered 2 months early and she had to spend 6 weeks in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit in a hospital more than 20 miles from our home. My husband had to go back to work within 2 weeks of the medical crisis because we could not afford to have him take any unpaid time away. It was extremely difficult for me to manage alone. Now, nearly 30 years later, families will have the grace to care for themselves or each other during serious events without having to worry about going bankrupt. Benefits start in December of 2028. The paid family and medical leave program provides up to 12 weeks of job-protected, paid leave at 80% of wages, capped at the state average weekly wage. It’s a universal program so that roughly 3.5 million working Virginians will be covered when they are welcoming a new baby, caring for themselves or a loved one during a serious illness, welcoming a loved one in the military back home after being in combat, or when a parent needs care at the end of their life. Our bill also gives grace to those who need paid leave because of a dangerous domestic situation. Did you know that among developed economies, the United States is the only country that does not guarantee paid maternity leave in the world? Small businesses support paid family and medical leave programs - it is the most affordable way to provide benefits to their employees, allowing them to compete with larger companies. My bill offers a special benefit to employers of 10 or fewer employees - there is no employer contribution to the fund. Everyone should have that grace when they or their loved ones need care during these most profound life events. SB 2 makes that a reality for Virginia’s working families. I thank my Chief of Staff Karen Harrison, who has been the bedrock keeping this momentum moving forward for nearly a decade, the many stakeholders especially Freedom Virginia our state partners over the past 3 years, the Campaign For a Family Friendly Economy, who started the groundwork in 2018, our brothers and sisters in the labor community and our national stakeholders who have worked with me all 8 sessions, and all of my colleagues who have supported this legislation consistently over the years. Kindest regards, Jennifer B. BoyskoMember, Senate of Virginia Representing the 38th Senate District making up the northernmost portions of Fairfax County (Great Falls, Herndon, McLean, Reston, Wolf Trap, parts of unincorporated Vienna and a slice of Falls Church) PS If you would like to support my work, please visit =. name: Kiros for Congress
subject: We are building power in Denver
body:
There’s a place for you in this campaign—if you want it
| |
---
| Hi Peter,

We're here in Denver, organizing every week — knocking doors, talking to neighbors, and building a campaign that doesn't take corporate PAC money. We're not taking our foot off the gas.

Between now and June 30, we need to have conversations with over 100,000 Denver voters. We've already reached tens of thousands. We need you for the rest.

If you've been on this list for a while but haven't made it to an event yet, that's completely okay. People plug in at different times. But if you are ready, this week is a good moment to start. [Come canvass with us](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/H0Tzbm1Z4OYZRpjBRZzHIqLVisNZJNAZ/click?signature=6b49fd8a3dca767a4907dd8b354a2b9ff355e157&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fcanvass) No experience needed—you’ll go out with a partner and get trained before you knock your first door.

If canvassing isn’t your step yet, that’s okay. There are other ways in:
* **[Phonebank from home](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/H0Tzbm1Z4OYZRpjBRZzHIqLVisNZJNAZ/click?signature=25f0ab90851ec98f1af040c669be796a9071ff65&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fphonebank)**. All you need is your phone or laptop.
* **[Attend a volunteer orientation](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/H0Tzbm1Z4OYZRpjBRZzHIqLVisNZJNAZ/click?signature=001e8b69eb8e0e62941462426b649079b24de4b1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fjoin-the-movement)**. Not sure where to start? We'll get you plugged in.

**
We’re organizing people to beat organized money—and there’s still a place for you if you want it.**
See you out there,

Rebecca Oliver
Organizing Director

subject: "chutzpah"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action
body:

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2272%2E259176%2EVZjxEi) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2272%2E259176%2EVZjxEi)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.14_Luria-Chutzpah_B2_F1_S14_C14_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=4&akid=2272%2E259176%2EVZjxEi) Peter, it’s Elaine Luria, and Blue Amp Action said I could reach out because it’s a pivotal moment for our campaign. The Virginia Supreme Court just struck down the new congressional map that Virginia voters passed last month. [**So, our race just became even more crucial to our battle for the House Majority. Before I get into my background and how I’m fighting back, will you split a $25 donation to flip VA-02?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.14_Luria-Chutzpah_B2_F1_S14_C14_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=5&akid=2272%2E259176%2EVZjxEi) | [DONATE $25](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.14_Luria-Chutzpah_B2_F1_S14_C14_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=6&akid=2272%2E259176%2EVZjxEi)
---
_Chutzpah_ — is a Yiddish term that means _guts_ or _courage._
In 1906, my great-grandfather left his home in Poland, made the long journey through Europe and across the Atlantic, and landed in Jasper, Alabama.
That took some serious _chutzpah._
My great-grandfather believed so strongly in the promise of America – a place where he could be Jewish without fear, where he could forge his own path – that he left his whole world behind.
That promise came true for him. He built a life, a family, and a proud community.
That’s what sets America apart, Peter. Here, anyone with a little _chutzpah_ is free to be whoever they want to be, do whatever they want to do, and achieve more than they ever dreamed.
In 1993, I joined the Navy to defend those freedoms.
In 2018, I ran for Congress to expand them.
In 2020, I won re-election to continue that work, making our nation free, safe, and prosperous.
In 2022, I served on the January 6th Committee because our Constitutional freedoms were threatened.
In 2026, I’m running for Congress again, because our current representative either _can’t_ or _won’t_ protect them.
The fact is that Coastal Virginia is in crisis. Our community’s been hit hard by this president’s failed agenda. **It’s time for action.**
Flipping Virginia’s Second District won’t be easy. Dark money groups and super PACs are watching closely, trying to see if we’re strong enough to pose a real threat. **This will be one of the toughest fights of the 2026 election cycle.**
Luckily, _chutzpah_ runs in my family. I’m not afraid of a little _mishigas._ And with you behind me, I’m ready to be the unapologetic champion Virginia families need.
[**Will you split a $25 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action to help me win this battleground race and restore America’s promise for ALL?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.05.14_Luria-Chutzpah_B2_F1_S14_C14_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=7&akid=2272%2E259176%2EVZjxEi)

The Virginia Supreme Court just struck down the new congressional map that Virginia voters passed last month. | Chutzpah — is a Yiddish term that means guts or courage. In 1906, my great-grandfather left his home in Poland, made the long journey through Europe and across the Atlantic, and landed in Jasper, Alabama. That took some serious chutzpah. My great-grandfather believed so strongly in the promise of America – a place where he could be Jewish without fear, where he could forge his own path – that he left his whole world behind. That promise came true for him. He built a life, a family, and a proud community. That’s what sets America apart, Peter. Here, anyone with a little chutzpah is free to be whoever they want to be, do whatever they want to do, and achieve more than they ever dreamed. In 1993, I joined the Navy to defend those freedoms. In 2018, I ran for Congress to expand them. In 2020, I won re-election to continue that work, making our nation free, safe, and prosperous. In 2022, I served on the January 6th Committee because our Constitutional freedoms were threatened. In 2026, I’m running for Congress again, because our current representative either can’t or won’t protect them. The fact is that Coastal Virginia is in crisis. Our community’s been hit hard by this president’s failed agenda. It’s time for action. Flipping Virginia’s Second District won’t be easy. Dark money groups and super PACs are watching closely, trying to see if we’re strong enough to pose a real threat. This will be one of the toughest fights of the 2026 election cycle. Luckily, chutzpah runs in my family. I’m not afraid of a little mishigas. And with you behind me, I’m ready to be the unapologetic champion Virginia families need. | | | | | | Dear Volunteers,
Thank you all so much for your help with our launch party last week! Thanks to you, we had an incredibly successful party, where hundreds of people got to see the energy behind our people powered campaign campaign, and to help build the Indianapolis we all envision.
Our Party for the People, however, only touched one part of our diverse city. I want to make sure that folks from all neighborhoods and all walks of life get a chance to meet me and tell me their vision for the future of Indianapolis. To do that, I need your help!
* I need volunteers for our **May Porch Parties**. At these parties, you’ll have a chance to help reach out to our community and get them to join our movement. [_Sign up here to help with the porch parties_](https://us.list-manage.com/7LWNKqXdSAE?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) _!_

| | [_**The Master Class Of Andrea Hunley**_](https://us.list-manage.com/YaFCF0ZTdwB?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) 4/6— Indianapolis Monthly
Hunley has a knack for simultaneously championing people and rallying support, from her family to her professional community. While the secret to her winning approach—her powerful relationships—is obvious, it goes beyond what any headline can capture.
Hunley’s aim is not only to be worthy of others’ trust. It’s also to affirm her trust in those around her—and their trust in each other. She wants to build a culture founded on accountability.

[_**Sen. Andrea Hunley tells IndyStar she's running for Indianapolis mayor**_](https://us.list-manage.com/ylRwVnLIUK6?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) 4/20— Indy Star
"I've been serving in a leadership position for 20 years in our city, and I've seen the city from multiple perspectives," Hunley told IndyStar in a phone interview. "I've seen it from inside of a classroom, seen it from inside of the Statehouse. I've seen it from partnerships with nonprofits and our big Fortune 500 companies. And I've seen it from inside of my neighborhood. I think that perspective allows me to see the challenges that the city has differently, but also see the possibilities differently."

---
| |
---
| | _**Indy mayor candidate Andrea Hunley talks to IndyStar about education, data centers**_ 5/11— Indy Star
“We also have to handle the basics. We've got to fix the potholes. We've got to make sure that all of our neighborhoods are invested in. We've got to make sure that we're taking care of our housing challenges. And we've got to make sure that we are taking care of our challenges with our young people who feel like they don't have a lot of opportunities.”

[ _**Andrea Hunley wants to build a people-powered campaign**_](https://us.list-manage.com/qx8liE2UaXx?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) 5/11— Mirror Indy
The teacher inside Hunley still comes out sometimes. When it was her turn to take the mic, she asked the audience to indulge her with a group activity: Close your eyes and imagine the Indianapolis you want to see 10 years from now. She paused for a moment, then shared her vision.
“I see a city where our riverfront is alive with trails and parks and music, and people not just visiting the city and passing through for an event, but a city where people are planting down roots,” she said. “I see a city known as the women’s sports capital of the world. I see public schools so strong that when people say ‘school choice,’ staying in Indianapolis is the obvious answer.”

Dear Fellow American, **800,000 dirty names.** That is how many inactive or ineligible voters Oregon must _review_ and _remove_ from their voter registration list because of the **legal settlement** the state just entered with Judicial Watch. **That means 800,000 opportunities for voter fraud have been _eliminated_. ** This **historic victory** for election integrity was the direct result of **Judicial Watch** 's lawsuit filed under the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA). | [FUEL OUR NEXT WIN FOR HONEST ELECTIONS ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81500&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
**Judicial Watch** NVRA lawsuits and legal action have now been responsible for _removing over 6 million dirty voter names_ from rolls in _over 12 states nationwide_. This _unprecedented_ voter roll cleanup effort is only possible **thanks to the generous tax-deductible support of Judicial Watch donors**. _[Will you join their ranks today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81500&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)_ to fund more voter roll cleanup? | [KEEP THE MOMENTUM GOING ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81500&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
Our lawsuit exposed egregious voter roll hygiene in Oregon with **35 of 36 counties** having overall **_registration rates _exceeding 100%___._** That makes this legally binding settlement a _huge victory for faith and confidence_ in the electoral process which requires Oregon to:
* Open its voter roll maintenance process to unprecedented scrutiny
* Regularly provide county-level data on voter registrations, removals, confirmations, and inactive voters.
* Allow ongoing monitoring of compliance
* Provide annual updates to **Judicial Watch** along with free access to the state's voter registration list...upon request.

Generous _[tax-deductible contributions](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81500&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)_ are what fuels our world class election integrity legal team and the _countless_ hours of research and preparedness which make Judicial Watch the country's most effective election integrity litigator. And I must also emphasize that our work cleaning up voter rolls is FAR from finished; _our team estimates that there are still** _18 million_** dirty voter names on rolls around the country_! So if you're able to, please make an additional contribution to _[lay the groundwork for the NEXT 6 million ineligible voters which need to be removed](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81500&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)_. | [FUND OUR NEXT VOTER ROLL LAWSUIT ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=81500&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
With your support, we will never stop fighting for clean voter rolls, because YOU deserve to have faith and confidence in our elections. **Thank you** for reading my message and for all you do to support election integrity. Sincerely, Tom Fitton

RFK Jr. has never been shy about calling out regulatory failures.

And now tinnitus is on the list.

According to RFK-backed researchers, the FDA dismissed early findings that showed tinnitus wasn’t an ear problem at all — but a misfiring signal loop inside the brain.

That decision shaped decades of failed treatments.

Why hearing aids don’t work.

Why masking sounds stop helping.

Why pills do nothing.

Now independent researchers are revisiting those buried findings — and the implications are alarming for anyone already hearing buzzing, ringing, or hissing.

A brief video explains what was overlooked — and why ignoring it could make tinnitus permanent.

body:
Peter, I wanted to provide an
update of where things stand right now.

No matter what happens next — no matter whether Tennessee ends up using
the old maps or these new, racist maps that seek to eliminate our
district’s identity — I’m still running to represent TN-09.

Our Movement fully supports the lawsuit to overturn this blatant
gerrymander. We’re fighting this in the courts, in the streets, and by
organizing our neighbors, because we need to make it crystal clear to MAGA
Republicans that we refuse to yield.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260514-jp.k64Egs&refcode=em20260514-37777&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1001&akid=37777%2E1203867%2Eh4PLns ]But we can’t do this work without you,
Peter. I hope you’ll join our campaign in our
fight to restore our right to fair representation by splitting
$10 or anything you can spare right now between our campaign
and Justice Democrats.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260514-jp.k64Egs&refcode=em20260514-37777&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=37777%2E1203867%2Eh4PLns ]Chip in $10 now! →

Let’s be clear about why we’re here. We’re here because the far-right
knows they can’t win fair and square.

So they’ve rigged the playing field. They’ve redrawn the board. And
they’re trying to choose their voters, instead of letting voters choose
their leaders.

They want to disrespect our dignity for the sake of politics. They want to
roll back our hard-fought rights. And they want to manipulate our
democracy behind closed doors.

I won’t stand for it, and I know you won’t either.

Whether we run in the “old” or “new” District 9, our vision for the future
hasn’t changed. We’re still going to fight against xAI and other polluters
for clean water to drink and clean air to breathe. We’re still going to
fight to end gun violence that keeps stealing our loved ones. And we’re
still going to fight a democracy that belongs to the People — not to
lobbyists, special interests, and not to politicians who are terrified of
losing power.

That’s why this moment matters so much. Because this isn’t just about
lines on a map. It’s about whether our community gets a voice at all.

But keeping our district’s voice alive is going to take resources.
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260514-jp.k64Egs&refcode=em20260514-37777&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=37777%2E1203867%2Eh4PLns ]That’s why I’m asking you to split $10 or more in the
next 30 minutes so we can close the gap to $100,000 and keep our momentum
going in this critical moment.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260514-jp.k64Egs&refcode=em20260514-37777&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1022&akid=37777%2E1203867%2Eh4PLns ]Contribute $10

In Love and Service,

Justin J. Pearson

Friend — This should alarm every American.
Donald Trump is now openly building what he’s calling an “election integrity army” ahead of the midterms — a coordinated effort to flood polling places and election systems with partisan operatives loyal to Trump.
Let’s call this what it is:
It’s dangerous. It’s authoritarian. And it’s completely against the spirit of a free democracy.
Electing Steve Toth in this environment would be like pouring gasoline on a fire:
After the 2020 election, Toth supported efforts to overturn legitimate election results instead of respecting the will of voters.
If you’re ready to fight back, to say no to fascistic election takeovers, and to say no to Steve Toth, chip in $20, $35, or whatever you can right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/finnie_em?refcode=em0514]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. This is bigger than one election now. It’s about whether people in power will accept democratic outcomes at all.

TX-02 is a must-win swing district, and this race will help decide whether people who attack democracy gain more power — or get stopped. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/finnie_em?refcode=em0514]

name: Katie Porter
subject: What I’ve heard on the campaign trail

body:
These are real problems happening in every corner of our state, and they won’t be solved by politicians who don’t live them.
#
Peter, I’ve been on the road on my Whiteboard Warriors Tour, hosting town halls across the state—and I want to share exactly what I’ve been hearing.
**No matter where I go, the message is the same: working people are just stretched too thin. They’re doing everything right, and _still_ falling behind.**
I’ve talked to parents working full-time who still can’t afford child care. Small business owners who are barely hanging on while big corporations rake in record profits. Families watching their budgets tighten every month as rent keeps going up.
These are real problems happening in every corner of our state, and they won’t be solved by politicians who don’t live them.
I’m a single mom. I’ve had to budget every dollar, struggle to make cuts, and figure out how to make it all work. And I’ll tell you this: _the people in charge right now aren’t feeling that pressure—but they should be._
I’m running for governor to put working Californians first and tackle the affordability crisis head-on. That means single-payer health care, free child care, less expensive housing, and more.
**This tour is about more than just sharing my plan. It’s how I hear directly from Californians and fight to make these solutions real.**
And I’m doing it without taking a single penny from corporate PACs—because we deserve a governor who isn’t owned by billionaires or special interests.
**[But being on the road and hosting these town halls takes real resources. If you’re able, I’m asking you to chip in $15 or whatever makes sense to you today so I can keep reaching voters, hearing their stories, and fighting for a more affordable California.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/104345?refcode=em20260514-10441&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=15&t=1&akid=10441%2E614464%2EO2Gzcb)**

Now he’s facing 99 years in prison |
---

* * *
Dear Friend, My name is Kimberly Bretches. I'm a wife and a mother of four young children. And I'm writing to you today because I am out of options and I am terrified. I'll be honest, asking strangers for help doesn't come naturally to me. But neither does the idea of my husband spending the rest of his life in prison for doing his job — so here I am. Chance is a police officer in Austin, Texas. He is, without question, the best man I know. He has spent his career keeping dangerous people off the streets, protecting a city that doesn't always make it easy to do so, and coming home every night to a family that needs him. His supervisors have praised him for his professionalism, for his instincts, for his dedication. He is exactly the kind of officer you want showing up when things go wrong. | By every measure, Chance did everything right. He used department-approved tools, following his training, to protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin.
---
And in May of 2020, things went very wrong in Austin. For three consecutive days, our city was under siege. Violent agitators hurled rocks, frozen water bottles, and exploding fireworks directly at police officers. Buildings were vandalized and looted. Police vehicles were set on fire. A rioter was caught with a Molotov cocktail. Officers were injured. The city was teetering on the edge of complete chaos, and everyone knew it.
On May 31st, the third day, when the mob was larger and more dangerous than it had ever been, Chance was on the front lines. He did what he was trained to do. He deployed non-lethal, department-approved beanbag projectiles to stop the aggression and protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin. The crowd eventually dispersed. The city held.
**No one questioned what he did that night. His supervisors praised his response. His department stood behind him.**
And then Austin elected District Attorney José Garza.
Instead of holding the rioters accountable — the ones who threw the fireworks, who lit the fires, who carried the Molotov cocktails — Garza turned his attention to the officers who stopped them. He launched an indiscriminate campaign against law enforcement, using the power of his office not to protect the public, but to make political examples out of good cops.
Chance became one of his targets.
| Chance now faces up to 99 Years in prison — for following his training.
---
My husband now faces up to 99 years in prison. Not because he did anything wrong. Not because his department found fault with his actions. Not because any credible review of that night concluded he acted improperly. But because one politically-motivated prosecutor decided the officers who held the line deserved to be punished for holding it. This case has been grinding through the system for years now. The trial has already been delayed several times and is **now scheduled for June of this year.** Every continuance, every filing, every hearing means more hours of legal work, and more bills our family has to find a way to pay. I am asking for your help because we cannot do this alone. The National Center for Police Defense has been in Chance's corner, and your donation goes toward funding his legal defense, ensuring he has the representation he deserves as he walks into that courtroom in June.

On May 31st, the third day, when the mob was larger and more dangerous than it had ever been, Chance was on the front lines. He did what he was trained to do. He deployed non-lethal, department-approved beanbag projectiles to stop the aggression and protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin. The crowd eventually dispersed. The city held. No one questioned what he did that night. His supervisors praised his response. His department stood behind him. And then Austin elected District Attorney José Garza. Instead of holding the rioters accountable — the ones who threw the fireworks, who lit the fires, who carried the Molotov cocktails — Garza turned his attention to the officers who stopped them. He launched an indiscriminate campaign against law enforcement, using the power of his office not to protect the public, but to make political examples out of good cops. Chance became one of his targets. | Chance now faces up to 99 Years in prison — for following his training. My husband now faces up to 99 years in prison. Not because he did anything wrong. Not because his department found fault with his actions. Not because any credible review of that night concluded he acted improperly. But because one politically-motivated prosecutor decided the officers who held the line deserved to be punished for holding it. This case has been grinding through the system for years now. The trial has already been delayed several times and is now scheduled for June of this year. Every continuance, every filing, every hearing means more hours of legal work, and more bills our family has to find a way to pay. I am asking for your help because we cannot do this alone. The National Center for Police Defense has been in Chance's corner, and your donation goes toward funding his legal defense, ensuring he has the representation he deserves as he walks into that courtroom in June. | · · - · or any amount you can give If you believe that the men and women who run toward danger deserve better than this, . Whatever you can. No amount is too small, and our family will not forget it. Chance stood between Austin and chaos on May 31st, 2020. He didn't hesitate. He didn't run. He did his job. Now I'm asking you to stand with him. With gratitude and hope, Kimberly Bretches Wife of Officer Chance Bretches, Austin Police Department | P.S. Chance's trial is this June. We are closer than we've ever been to getting Chance in front of a jury that will hear the truth, but we need the resources to get there. ** National Center for Police Defense · Defenders for Justice

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMay 14, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**Letlow Calls on Fleming to Answer for D.C. Lobbying Firm Ties****BATON ROUGE, LA** — Congresswoman Julia Letlow [joined](https://us.list-manage.com/h1H9bBylXcq?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a) the nationally syndicated Todd Starnes Radio Show to discuss growing questions surrounding Louisiana State Treasurer John Fleming’s paid work for a Washington, D.C. lobbying firm while simultaneously serving as Louisiana’s elected treasurer.
During the interview, Letlow called Fleming’s arrangement a “huge breach of trust” and said the people of Louisiana deserve full transparency regarding his employment with the McKeon Group. Letlow also called on Fleming to release a complete accounting of the work he performed for the firm while serving as state treasurer and to clarify whether the arrangement was approved by the Louisiana Board of Ethics.
_“During our debate, John Fleming admitted that he is being paid by a Washington lobbying firm while also serving as Louisiana State Treasurer,”_ **said Rep. Letlow.** _“Louisiana taxpayers are paying his salary as treasurer while he is also collecting checks from a D.C. lobbying firm, and the people of our state deserve answers. We still do not know what work he was performing, who he was working for, or whether he was using his position to benefit federal clients.”_
**Letlow continued:**
_“This is exactly why people are fed up with career politicians and the Washington swamp. Louisianans want leaders they can trust to put our state first, not politicians who spend decades cashing in and working both sides. I called on John Fleming to resign from the lobbying firm and provide full transparency because the people of Louisiana deserve accountability.”_
The interview followed Letlow’s strong performance in the Louisiana Senate debate, where Fleming publicly acknowledged his paid relationship with the Washington lobbying firm while serving as state treasurer.
Congresswoman Letlow is the Trump-endorsed conservative in Louisiana’s U.S. Senate race and is running to bring strong America First leadership to the Senate.

Lobbying Firm TiesBATON ROUGE, LA — Congresswoman Julia Letlow the nationally syndicated Todd Starnes Radio Show to discuss growing questions surrounding Louisiana State Treasurer John Fleming’s paid work for a Washington, D.C. lobbying firm while simultaneously serving as Louisiana’s elected treasurer. During the interview, Letlow called Fleming’s arrangement a “huge breach of trust” and said the people of Louisiana deserve full transparency regarding his employment with the McKeon Group. Letlow also called on Fleming to release a complete accounting of the work he performed for the firm while serving as state treasurer and to clarify whether the arrangement was approved by the Louisiana Board of Ethics. “During our debate, John Fleming admitted that he is being paid by a Washington lobbying firm while also serving as Louisiana State Treasurer,” said Rep. Letlow. “Louisiana taxpayers are paying his salary as treasurer while he is also collecting checks from a D.C. lobbying firm, and the people of our state deserve answers. We still do not know what work he was performing, who he was working for, or whether he was using his position to benefit federal clients.” Letlow continued: “This is exactly why people are fed up with career politicians and the Washington swamp. cadem.org [cadem.org]
California Democrats,
Even after Trump’s Supreme Court weakened protections for fair representation in states like Virginia and gutted the Voting Rights Act, California is continuing the fight to protect democracy and expand Democratic representation at home.
We know what's at stake with this year's elections, and CADEM's Voter Protection Team—the oldest and most robust voter protection program in the country—is key to ensuring voters have the access, information and confidence they need to cast their ballot and make their voice heard.
With the June 2 Primary Election less than 3 weeks away, it's critical that we stay in the fight to flip seats so that we can take back the House and protect our democracy. Join us to get out the vote THIS Saturday on our Statewide Day of Action! [cadem.org/may16]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/412F544A32524E6948494C797470636E70587776545562436A58554E6C686E6A2F4D324F54507364445848352F774C43764C4E36447A486C6651583664617A2F/editor_images/OIA%20ICYMI%20Banner.png]
California voters have ballots in-hand, which means every day between now and June 2 is Election Day! Check out CADEM's online endorsement tool [https://cadem.org/our-endorsements/] to find endorsed Democrats where you live, and visit our Voter Information page [https://cadem.org/vote/] to find all the resources you need to vote. Here are important dates voters should know:
* May 4: Ballots mailed to all registered voters [https://registertovote.ca.gov/]
* May 5: Official ballot drop-boxes [https://caearlyvoting.sos.ca.gov/] opened
* May 18: Last day to register to vote online [https://registertovote.ca.gov/]
* May 19 – June 2: Same-day voter registration is available
* May 23: Vote centers [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/polling-place] open
* May 26: Recommended vote-by-mail [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/voter-registration/vote-mail] return date to ensure your ballot is postmarked by Election Day
* June 2: ELECTION DAY! [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/polling-place] Ballots must be postmarked by this date or dropped off by 8PM when polls close.
On Tuesday this week, we kicked off our first Spanish language phonebank [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/947093/] of the year! Led by our California Latino Coalition, volunteers are calling Spanish-speaking voters every Tuesday from 5:30-7:30 PM in target Congressional districts to talk about the issues they care about and encourage them to make a plan to vote. Do you speak Spanish? Invite a friend and join next Tuesday's phonebank [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/947093/] to help us Take Back the House!
At this week's Rural Coalition meeting, we reviewed a recent presentation from Rural Urban Bridge Initiative, discussed the importance of direct voter contact and set a goal to complete 40 phonebank shifts as a coalition by the end of the month. The Rural Coalition will also be participating in this Saturday's Statewide Day of Action, and will meet again next Thursday, May 21 [https://cadem-org.smailroute.net/x/d?c=51159583&l=a891dd76-c8b8-4067-809d-5168a4ea5923&r=f0e24318-e14a-476b-a124-563cc75e66fa] . Anyone living in a rural part of the state is welcome to join the coalition!
CADEM’s Organizing Committee met last week to prepare as we ramp up our Get Out the Vote efforts across the state. California voters have their ballots in-hand, and we're doing all we can to ensure every eligible voter makes their voice heard on June 2 Election Day.

Please, take a moment to read this.
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012QxJ1hJZLRc-Ou9LyBDW1O_9cpn1Brj3N9gvpT4PydrI947mWWODfVNDE3xViVQcVrGDz8B14k68XDdEVsWlXT6FG3MLIWiEH7WT7VPQw4nN02IA8wJtmaUetYvQqcOWZdwGPFwSDVSd7qx0otdbbkYE7RNd_5_lW_lqEF1hIuS31ZGoV5RG9DYhjW73NpqonsosUOaS6ksjEjFkEVaerO2PqGJCSbGd&c=dRTSm1TT8ue9a2FinQz-A2t7o9yv9umQlrPwueGjb9JGW6r_CkZ-7Q==&ch=EvBXquqSjr4D0VTFqV04vUVphGSeJFNGj2MXyf9fxPrRqy1Y_GXEiA==)

| Peter,
Two days.
That's all we have left until primary day, and I wanted to take a moment to write you personally about where we are and what's ahead.
I'm taking a quick break from knocking doors, and I've got to tell you -- we're feeling good. The momentum is real. Democratic turnout is surging. We're building something special here in Louisiana.
But if there's one thing I've learned in all my years on this earth, it's that you can never take your foot off the gas. Especially not now. Especially not when we're this close.
This campaign has been a rollercoaster I could never have imagined.
We've had incredible highs -- watching Democrats flip Trump districts by massive margins, seeing our grassroots movement grow beyond anything I dreamed possible, feeling the energy shift as Louisiana became genuinely competitive for the first time in decades.
And we've had devastating lows -- SCOTUS gutting the Voting Rights Act that my ancestors fought and died for, Governor Landry trying to cancel our elections, watching MAGA extremists do everything in their power to suppress our vote and silence our voices.
There were moments when the uncertainty felt overwhelming. When the obstacles seemed insurmountable. When it would have been easier to just accept that Louisiana stays red and nothing ever changes here.
But you know what happened instead?
Democrats got fired up.
Every time MAGA threw another obstacle in our way, our movement got stronger. Every time they tried to suppress our vote, more people showed up determined to make their voices heard. Every time they thought they'd broken our spirit, we came back twice as strong.
That's what I'm most proud of about this campaign: The fact that when faced with a coordinated attempt to steal our democracy, Louisiana Democrats said "hell no" and fought back.
My grandfather was a sharecropper. He worked land he'd never own. He lived in a time when powerful people could cancel elections, suppress votes, and rig the system with impunity -- and there was nothing he could do about it.
But his grandson? His grandson is two days away from potentially becoming Louisiana's first Black Senator since Reconstruction. His grandson is watching a movement of everyday Louisianans stand up to MAGA extremism and say "not here, not now, not ever."
That's only possible because people like you refused to give up.
I've put everything into this race. My time, my energy, my heart. I've spent months crisscrossing this state, talking to voters, building relationships, making the case that Louisiana is ready for change.
Now I'm asking you to give me a helping hand for these final two days.

clean_body: Please, take a moment to read this. | | | | | == | Peter, Two days. That's all we have left until primary day, and I wanted to take a moment to write you personally about where we are and what's ahead. I'm taking a quick break from knocking doors, and I've got to tell you -- we're feeling good. The momentum is real. Democratic turnout is surging. We're building something special here in Louisiana. But if there's one thing I've learned in all my years on this earth, it's that you can never take your foot off the gas. Especially not now. Especially not when we're this close. This campaign has been a rollercoaster I could never have imagined. We've had incredible highs -- watching Democrats flip Trump districts by massive margins, seeing our grassroots movement grow beyond anything I dreamed possible, feeling the energy shift as Louisiana became genuinely competitive for the first time in decades. And we've had devastating lows -- SCOTUS gutting the Voting Rights Act that my ancestors fought and died for, Governor Landry trying to cancel our elections, watching MAGA extremists do everything in their power to suppress our vote and silence our voices. There were moments when the uncertainty felt overwhelming. When the obstacles seemed insurmountable. When it would have been easier to just accept that Louisiana stays red and nothing ever changes here. But you know what happened instead? Democrats got fired up. Every time MAGA threw another obstacle in our way, our movement got stronger. Every time they tried to suppress our vote, more people showed up determined to make their voices heard. Every time they thought they'd broken our spirit, we came back twice as strong. That's what I'm most proud of about this campaign: The fact that when faced with a coordinated attempt to steal our democracy, Louisiana Democrats said "hell no" and fought back. My grandfather was a sharecropper. He worked land he'd never own. He lived in a time when powerful people could cancel elections, suppress votes, and rig the system with impunity -- and there was nothing he could do about it. But his grandson? His grandson is two days away from potentially becoming Louisiana's first Black Senator since Reconstruction. His grandson is watching a movement of everyday Louisianans stand up to MAGA extremism and say "not here, not now, not ever." That's only possible because people like you refused to give up. I've put everything into this race. My time, my energy, my heart. I've spent months crisscrossing this state, talking to voters, building relationships, making the case that Louisiana is ready for change. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Add your name if you endorse my plan to reform the Supreme Court
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2902%2E4032634%2EuMTADo)
---
I don’t know about you, but I’m sick and tired of waking up every day waiting on pins and needles to learn whether or not Trump’s hand-picked Supreme Court is going to uphold our rights. Right now, we are one court ruling away from women losing access to mifepristone — the safest, most common form of abortion in America. The Court also just took a sledgehammer to one of the most important civil rights laws in American history — opening the floodgates for states like Alabama and Tennessee to silence Black voters and redraw their Congressional maps. How can we stop a small group of people from drowning out the will of the people? Our immediate priority is to take back our Senate majority. Donald Trump could appoint two more justices to the Supreme Court if he has the Senate votes to confirm them — and we must put an immediate check on this. But I'm also keeping an eye on the big picture: reforming the Court. **That means passing my Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act — and expanding the Court to rebalance it.** My plan would:
* Require Supreme Court justices to follow a binding Code of Conduct
* Strengthen restrictions on judicial gifts and privately funded travel
* Ban judges from owning individual stocks and securities, commercial real estate, trusts, and private companies (can you believe that’s not the law already?)
* Overhaul the broken recusal process, so Supreme Court justices would have to publicly respond — and justify their decision — if a litigant in a case asks the justice to recuse themselves

**There are real solutions to the root cause of this crisis but it’s going to take big ideas — and big, structural changes.** [**Add your name if you endorse this plan. To undo the damage done by the right-wing takeover of our federal courts, we must take back the Senate to block Trump from nominating two more justices, root corruption out of the judiciary, and rebalance the Supreme Court by expanding it.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-judicialethics/?source=EW_EMZ31G_SCO_ENG_20260514_F&t=8&akid=2902%2E4032634%2EuMTADo) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-judicialethics/?source=EW_EMZ31G_SCO_ENG_20260514_F&t=9&akid=2902%2E4032634%2EuMTADo)

Elizabeth

and access the Live Capitalist chat](https://substack.com/redirect/0d1707a3-4f4a-4964-a1e8-d73f19d20e90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Subscribe here now](https://substack.com/redirect/0d1707a3-4f4a-4964-a1e8-d73f19d20e90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Zohran Mamdani's toxic Tax Day TikTok disaster is continuing to mushroom and nearly a month later the cost to New York is now **staggering.** The public shaming of Ken Griffin a man who built one of the most successful hedge funds on the planet, blew up exactly as anyone with a functioning brain could have predicted..
**The consequences didn 't take long to appear.** Within days Griffin made it official: Citadel would double down on Miami, adding more jobs there as a direct consequence of the mayor's stunt. No vague threats. No polite hedging. Just cold, rational capital going where it is wanted.
Here is the part that should terrify every working New Yorker who still believes the city can afford Mamdani's fantasies: the moment Griffin moved, others followed. The dam broke.
They weren't impressed. They weren't interested in waiting to become Mamdani's next target. Apollo Global Management, a $900 billion Wall Street titan, decided it had seen enough. The firm is now opening a major new hub in either Florida or Texas and relocating a thousand employees--exactly matching its current New York headcount. One thousand high-paying jobs. Just like that.
This is not scattered grumbling. This is a ball rolling down hill gathering momentum. Don't forget dear reader, Mamdani's term is four years, we're only 5 months in.

# [The "Trump Effect" on IRAs over $50k](https://substack.com/redirect/d9246446-2e4f-4ef8-a359-12a2ad7770d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

"President Trump's **" One Big Beautiful Bill"** is exactly what this country needs. It's big, it's bold, and it's finally putting American families first.
But we have to be honest with you about something that's hard to say.
Trump's new plan is moving fast... maybe too fast for the old, fragile banking system to handle.
If you leave your money sitting there, **[it could get caught in the shake-up."](https://substack.com/redirect/d9246446-2e4f-4ef8-a359-12a2ad7770d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Click here to learn more](https://substack.com/redirect/d9246446-2e4f-4ef8-a359-12a2ad7770d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
The pro-business Partnership for New York City ran the numbers and delivered the verdict Mamdani's crowd are seemingly unable to comprehend.
**[His rhetoric risks losing](https://substack.com/redirect/26e2eaa5-5237-49d0-8de1-bb3c0fdf0294?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** 2,700 jobs in the financial industry and $168 million in state and city tax revenue every single year. Let that sink in. Apollo alone paid roughly $1.28 billion in total income taxes in 2025. Citadel executives and their teams have paid nearly $2.3 billion in city and state taxes over the past five years. Griffin himself has directed $650 million in charity to everything from hospitals to charter schools. These are not idle rich. They are engines. And engines, when kicked hard enough, move.
_**" The golden goose of New York City is heading South in Spirit Airlines," joked pro-business lobbyist James "Cadillac" McMahon.**_
Mamdani's defenders will call this an overreaction. (They always do.) They will insist the rich should simply **[accept the shaming, pay up, and stay put](https://substack.com/redirect/548b27b0-e9a0-48b4-a934-6c62f1b5fa12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** like good little cash machines. But capital is not sentimental. It is mobile. Griffin already lived through this movie in Chicago--under leaders who turned success into a crime and watched the city bleed out. He sees the same script playing in New York now, and he is not repeating the trauma. The man who once called Miami the future of finance long before Mamdani became mayor has simply accelerated the inevitable. And every other executive watching the video, reading the headlines, and calculating the new tax proposals reached the same conclusion: why stay and be next?
## [Mamdani's tone deaf TikTok stunt blows up in his face](https://substack.com/redirect/083ea61f-6a99-4daa-8c50-ef3e92b4d635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[](https://substack.com/redirect/083ea61f-6a99-4daa-8c50-ef3e92b4d635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Things got worse precisely because the stunt was so personal. Mamdani didn't issue a dry policy paper. He staged a spectacle in front of a private home, camera rolling, to broadcast "we're taxing the rich" like some teenage revolutionary. It played badly because it was bad. It turned a debate about fiscal policy into a public execution. Successful businessmen do not enjoy being cast as villains in someone else's morality play. They have options. They exercise them.
The alternative options are piling up. Texas Governor Greg Abbott is not waiting politely in the wings. **[He is out with a direct pitch to disillusioned New Yorkers](https://substack.com/redirect/c758060e-0a81-4e9a-a4ef-909085bb93b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : come south, where there is no state income tax, reasonable regulations, and a government that still understands free enterprise. His spokesman put it plainly--punitive policies targeting job creators only accelerate the trend. Texas has already surpassed New York in financial sector employment: 519,000 jobs to New York's 507,000. JPMorgan now employs more people in Texas than in the city that used to be its undisputed home. The numbers are not opinions. They are receipts.
## [Mamdani begs the rich not to flee New York as his socialist dream collapses](https://substack.com/redirect/548b27b0-e9a0-48b4-a934-6c62f1b5fa12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[](https://substack.com/redirect/548b27b0-e9a0-48b4-a934-6c62f1b5fa12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Mamdani's earlier pleas that the rich simply "pay more so everyone can stay" now read like dark comedy. He stood at a podium and asked the very people he is chasing away to fund his vision of affordability. The math never worked. It still doesn't. Raise corporate taxes from 7.25 percent to 11.5 percent, slap a two-point surcharge on millionaires, and watch the revenue base evaporate. Jamie Dimon said it plainly months ago: New York already carries the highest city and state taxes in the country. Companies need to compete. **They are not required to subsidize their own execution.** History already proved this once. In the 1970s nearly half the Fortune 500 companies based in New York fled soaring taxes, rents, and hostility. The city nearly went bankrupt. Mamdani is running the same experiment with fresh slogans and worse timing.

* * *
**[Become a paid subscriber today and access the Live Capitalist chat](https://substack.com/redirect/0d1707a3-4f4a-4964-a1e8-d73f19d20e90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Have a view? Let us know!](https://substack.com/redirect/38cc5c8c-fd73-4e9c-8f24-d99522c89296?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
The working people Mamdani claims to champion will not be spared. They inherit the wreckage--higher property taxes on smaller paychecks, crumbling infrastructure, and a city that no longer attracts the talent that once made it hum. This is not theory. It is arithmetic. The top one percent already shoulder half the income tax revenue. Treat them like public enemies and they leave. The rest of us pay twice--once for the lost revenue and again with the slower, poorer city left behind. And then we'll leave too.
_**" Without finance jobs Manhattan is a very expensive mall," said Zilvinas Silenas, president of Empire Center for Public Policy.**_
Mamdani's office dodges, deflects, and insists the tax system is "broken" because it allows extreme wealth. Translation: success itself is the problem. That envy dressed up as justice has never funded a single subway car or classroom. It only accelerates the flight. Griffin's move was the spark. Apollo's decision the confirmation. The wave of other firms "quiet quitting" the city is the proof. Texas is not stealing New York's future. New York is throwing it away.
## [Pay up comrade, the Wealth Tax needs you](https://substack.com/redirect/824d3f29-c41b-4a74-9f1f-5ae4485253cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| Apr 30
[](https://substack.com/redirect/824d3f29-c41b-4a74-9f1f-5ae4485253cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/824d3f29-c41b-4a74-9f1f-5ae4485253cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/824d3f29-c41b-4a74-9f1f-5ae4485253cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This is what happens when performative populism meets economic reality. The likes pour in. The jobs pour out. The mayor who posed for the viral clip now watches the consequences unfold in real time because capital does not negotiate with people who treat it as prey.
New York is not too rich to fail. It is too hostile to stay rich. And the people who actually generate the wealth--the ones who pay the bills Mamdani loves to run up--have already started walking. The only question left is how many more will follow before the mayor finally understands that you cannot tax success out of existence without taxing everyone else into mediocrity.
The golden goose doesn't stick around for lectures. It flies south to its new home in Texas or Miami and it is not coming back.
Amidst all the doom and gloom there is one tiny spark of good news, Comrade Mamdani only has another 3 years and 7 months left in his term.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Friend, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. | | | | | | | | This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Friend, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. ## Data removal is difficult, by design

* Lengthy processes: email confirmations, ID verification--[even phone calls](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskLuO4zAMRb9G7mJQD0t2oWKBwF223dKQJcomVrECWXnM3w8cDDDzAVMegiTOvf8u08VRom35665o6yvmKWAg7yqGacPnnrBWLFNw1c0l_8eyu4KRlrXStsRcJgFCn6A7cfXjkjfBzhAG3qDlxvSm5wZUs1qthBYSAEB1SpuhU36QZkDseq9nFxuyx0PouOI9cCVa6DloLgFlwDAbyRRgoJpLW1es-HJ7TB_5gaX1-doku9Z625n8w8TIxBjQpZY2n5eNWspMjC7GyTM55hixTBSYPGsm9DF-A5fm4D3fi0cmz9-hDikm9L2kr82m2HB7Ukq0a8MULFdH6a1Rf7PKhxWfAQAA__9IC4sC)
* Your data [quietly reappears later](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskLuO4zAMRb9G7mJQD0t2oWKBwF223dKQJcomVrECWXnM3w8cDDDzAVMegiTOvf8u08VRom35665o6yvmKWAg7yqGacPnnrBWLFNw1c0l_8eyu4KRlrXStsRcJgFCn6A7cfXjkjfBzhAG3qDlxvSm5wZUs1qthBYSAEB1SpuhU36QZkDseq9nFxuyx0PouOI9cCVa6DloLgFlwDAbyRRgoJpLW1es-HJ7TB_5gaX1-doku9Z625n8w8TIxBjQpZY2n5eNWspMjC7GyTM55hixTBSYPGsm9DF-A5fm4D3fi0cmz9-hDikm9L2kr82m2HB7Ukq0a8MULFdH6a1Rf7PKhxWfAQAA__9IC4sC).

* Increased insurance premiums and loan denials

**Peter — I just introduced a bold plan in Congress to invest $10 billion a year for the next decade to make afterschool and summer learning programs accessible to all, regardless of income. Every child — especially those from low-income families – deserves safe, enriching opportunities to learn and grow.** As a dad raising five kids in lower Manhattan, I know that working families need reliable afterschool care. It’s critical to the safety and development of our children — a place where kids get healthy snacks, homework help, STEM exposure, sports, and a fun and safe place to grow. For working parents, afterschool programs are a lifeline that in many cases allows them to develop their careers. And it’s beneficial for our economy, as more parents can work full-time jobs and generate more economic output. That’s why I call it a **win-win-win**. clean_body: | Peter — I just introduced a bold plan in Congress to invest $10 billion a year for the next decade to make afterschool and summer learning programs accessible to all, regardless of income. Every child — especially those from low-income families – deserves safe, enriching opportunities to learn and grow. As a dad raising five kids in lower Manhattan, I know that working families need reliable afterschool care. It’s critical to the safety and development of our children — a place where kids get healthy snacks, homework help, STEM exposure, sports, and a fun and safe place to grow. For working parents, afterschool programs are a lifeline that in many cases allows them to develop their careers. And it’s beneficial for our economy, as more parents can work full-time jobs and generate more economic output. That’s why I call it a win-win-win. | The program is simple and powerful: it’s fully paid for by just a 1% increase in the corporate tax rate, and it would boost the economy and expand access for more than 10 million K–12 students across the country. Community organizations, including the Chinese-American Planning Council, Henry Street Settlement, and the Center for Family Life in Sunset Park, have already endorsed my approach because it scales services that are proven to work. That means safer afternoons, better grades, improved outcomes, and vital support for parents so they do not have to choose between their paychecks and their children’s safety and well-being. High-quality afterschool and summer programs improve grades and attendance, reduce juvenile crime, and help students build the skills that lead to higher lifetime earnings. clean_body: The Louisiana Senate just voted to eliminate my majority Black district. Dems losing the midterms just became a real possibility. | | | | | == | Peter, Ten minutes ago, I became the most vulnerable Democrat in all of Congress. This is Congressman Cleo Fields (D-LA) with an emergency update. Over the objection of hundreds of citizens and grassroots advocates who gave passionate public testimony demanding their voices be heard, the Louisiana Senate just steamrolled ahead and voted to eliminate my majority minority district. I have become the first domino to fall in a cascade that could wipe out as many as 25+ blue districts. Democrats losing the midterms is now a very real possibility if we don't take action. | == If they are successful in this endeavor we do not come back. We will lose the midterms this year. If you thought the last two years were bad, wait until a triumphant MAGA no longer has an impending election to restrain them. If we lose the midterms that's the whole ballgame. The nation is now relying on members of the Congressional Black Caucus like myself, whose districts are on the chopping block, to run and win in our new red districts or we don't take back Congress. They have me surrounded right now, but I am fighting this like our lives depend on it (because they do) and I will not give up this seat. == If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | == | == | == | | | == | == | == | == | Thank you for standing with us. Your support means everything. Together we will march on and we will prevail. No.

Elissa Slotkin

name: David Hogg
subject: Emails like this shouldn’t exist
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
And I mean that.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260514-1&t=1&akid=3477%2E587540%2ErDKK7M)
**Peter, I wish emails like this didn’t have to exist.**
_I mean that._
Every organization I’ve helped start has had a pretty terrible business model for one simple reason: I want the problems we’re fighting to actually get solved.
In 20 years, I don’t want to still be sending fundraising emails about gun violence or still need to raise millions to elect young people.
And I don’t want organizations like Leaders We Deserve to have to exist forever. I want us to elect the right people, level the playing field for young candidates, and finally fix the system that elects the politicians with the most money behind them.
I don’t think it’s too idealistic to believe we can build a country where young people actually have representation, where politicians aren’t owned by corporate PACs and mega donors, and where regular people don’t have to spend everyday terrified about what basic rights are on the chopping block next.
And to be honest, I hate asking for money.
I hate that so much of politics revolves around fundraising.
I hate that candidates spend a significant amount of time every day dialing for dollars instead of talking to voters, building policy, or governing. It’s a broken system, and we all know it. Elected officials should not have to be professional fundraisers.
**But here’s the reality we’re dealing with right now:**
Our opponents are backed corporate PACs and the same political machine that has spent decades building power at every level of government to the benefit of the ultra wealthy at the cost of the American Dream.
And we can’t afford to unilaterally disarm.
_That’s why Leaders We Deserve has to exist right now._
Because there are young progressive candidates across this country who are smart enough, talented enough, and courageous enough to lead — but the political establishment shuts too many of them out before they ever get a shot.
**Leaders We Deserve is working hard to change that by helping recruit, support, and elect the next generation of leaders in our state legislatures and Congress.**
This isn’t an easy battle, but it’s a fight worth having. There’s too much at stake to sit on the sidelines and let the same failed leaders steer us in the wrong direction.
**[Peter, will you make a $5 donation now to power this important work?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260514_1_goal.F9svNm&refcode=em20260514-3477&amount=5&t=2&akid=3477%2E587540%2ErDKK7M)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260514_1_goal.F9svNm&amount=5&refcode=em20260514-3477&t=21&akid=3477%2E587540%2ErDKK7M)**
It means a lot to me that you are willing to invest in this fight for our future. It gives me hope that we can create a future without emails like this one.
Thank you,
David Hogg

On April 21, the Charles County budget office proposed a record FY2027 General Fund budget of $641.8 million, a 7.9% increase over last year. The final vote is scheduled for Monday, May 12. Local leaders are quick to point out that the property tax rate is not going up, but there is so much more to it than that.

| | The truth is, when government keeps growing bigger and more expensive year after year, hardworking families are the ones who ultimately pay the price. Whether through higher fees or the pressure that runaway spending puts on the cost of living, families deserve better, and I am running for Congress to put an end to this kind of reckless spending. As a small business owner, I know what it takes to make a budget work. Every month, my husband and I sit down at the kitchen table and figure out how to make every dollar stretch further, just like our employees do at home and just like families across Southern Maryland do every day. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Donald Trump wants you to believe that this is who we are as a country.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We are here to say that it is not.
#
I have always felt that America has always been a place of two stories.
It has always been a place where we’ve seen the worst of humanity and the best of humanity. Witnessing the triumph of the best of us, over the worst of what we’ve seen, is also a very big part of who we are.
When it comes to ICE, it’s where both of these elements meet. I don’t think it’s a coincidence that this xenophobia and anti-immigrant feeling is happening at the same time as record levels of income inequality.
When you feel like “you could be next”, when you feel like you are one accident away from losing your house, or everything, the lesser impulse of us is to subjugate or to feel like there’s another class of people that is below us.
**Capitalism and our society requires us to internalize the failures of our system**.
It’s not the school that failed the kids, it's that _you’re the dropout_. It’s not that Walmart pays less than a living wage, it’s that _“I’m poor, and I didn’t work hard enough so I didn’t earn a better station in life.”_
We’ve internalized this moralized system: The economic elite are smarter, better, more sophisticated — _therefore_ , the people at the bottom are uneducated, lazy, etc.
In a history of racism and colonialism, this is served up to you on a platter. That’s Jim Crow, that’s racism, that’s a lot of this immigration story.
Another real problem in that code is that we start making exceptions to our values, exceptions to the society that we want to live in.
All of a sudden, we now have a paramilitary force that thinks they don’t need judicial warrants, so you don’t get due process.
We create this blackbox system where you can just point a finger — again, like we saw with Jim Crow — and accuse someone of something. If you think that once you build that machine that it’s reserved for that, **think again**.
These things eat _profit_. It’s not just ICE. It’s CoreCivic, it’s GEO Group. These are corporations that run ICE detention centers. They are for-profit. They are traded on Wall Street.
And what happens is that **this system does not accept anything but growth**.
It’s not enough to be profitable — you have to keep growing those profits.
And so once they’ve rounded up every “illegal” person in this country, **who do you think is next?**
Donald Trump wants you to believe that this is who we are as a country. **We are here to say that it is not**.
We are a country that has fought and defeated the confederacy. That has defeated a history of civil rights violations, of secret police, of fascism. We can, and will, again.
[Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260514.1lcPwX&refcode=em20260514-11426-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11426%2E2526796%2EnFzMee)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260514.1lcPwX&refcode=em20260514-11426-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=11426%2E2526796%2EnFzMee)**
In solidarity,
Alexandria

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

Friend, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. **Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you.** **[In light of America’s 250th birthday and the special opportunity we have to honor veterans this year, will you chip in today to help support the parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=08f23ed5b06241b2a3bdf663b43a51c6&_e=AZZZ8wDbtFy7yORbqreNRtl87S4XLc2_E9NesUX6PbRQISrR-QFAIPQF8ONzDA4727FVRR9RuSSlI3zH0VK6b_MMhsR5Lw2RV5cH5HLmpvXvW6YeFozO60ks0uuuJpHJ3LdrZJkrfQhB8tQxJb78jhZY0wBO0YWlBltMXyBQn67ZYYN4FcOI8FnTIw2tGTv_aShcyvXFguVtOj3mtXvE78Z6qovEc6IB0I-XttUN6iju_Q-sXzzBa2Q4FhvfhP8JLmF_XKG1Zmg5KWAYv8S4JAKoBAoB1-8du4KWmWI8k4ZM8uDFlFUFIsUEaipHQaHQSIabAzFAncrjwmt9b9TZorFGfrJw4klGDW0XfzZtSSYBLebPpcqbSwJThZauP49cMqYyhopNgXeFKj8GE4RtsvIxTqnlZbdjpKDI9xFXsapD4-mnEhhc-KKq72l-qSN0mNOmcXCAHfrd9WcBIXoY7CK8MoxSB_a0CtDb7mYOT8t--J3nnpry2KZ-X59RSrRFgYGMeDPQivkqVwYlE5qQ7gRD0In6wZfDtD6FlwjzsEIvBnD4iH2Kkp8ThuIHs59wSGNcrBUCLjxwkCbILMggNwk3mI1ZPqlPQJRejITQNWAth71PLs6X3R6UhZobERc1_3kA2T-lhG7LJDmml1U9dHCeUKZ840BPwDmjYfkU-1EJDY6e65NXITLKIXDV3NpG5g9PybNfDMBNq1jmK1y9kg%3D%3D)**
