I grew up right here in Western Pennsylvania, in Thornburg. That’s where I learned the Western PA values we all know: hard work, service, and love of country. These values have guided me throughout my life.
As a teenager, they led me to step up and serve our country after the 9/11 attacks. At 17 years old, I went off to the Naval Academy. I was commissioned as an active-duty naval officer and led Americans at sea and in Iraq.
After my time in the Navy, they led me to run for Congress. In the House, I’ve fought hard for the community that raised me. I’ve taken on out-of-control corporate power, worked to make life less of a ripoff, and fought to protect our democracy and our Constitution.
But Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share our values. They’d rather cower to the president and his weak agenda than put folks like us first. I mean, look at their track record: driving up costs with reckless tariffs, launching an unnecessary and deadly war with Iran, and letting corporate power run amok while ripping off hardworking people.
Frankly, I’m sick of it—and I’ll bet you are too.

Peter, tonight is the final debate before the June primary—the last debate voters will see before they make one of the _biggest_ decisions facing California.
So let me be very clear: Californians are being crushed by costs—rent, groceries, child care, health care—and too many politicians are acting like this is normal.
_I don’t agree._
**If corporations are jacking up prices and politicians are protecting the system that lets them do it for personal gain, then voters should have someone in this race willing to take them on directly.**
That’s why I’m running on single-payer health care, less expensive housing, free child care, tuition-free public college, and real accountability for the people and corporations driving up costs.
My opponents are comfortable with the way things are. _I’m not._
_Tonight, voters will see that difference one final time before casting their ballots._
With less than three weeks left, we’re in the most critical stretch of this campaign. We have to secure a spot in the top two to move on to November and make sure undecided voters hear our message long after the debate ends.
Unlike my opponents, I’m not relying on my own checks or corporate cash to power my campaign.
**I’m relying on grassroots supporters coming together, stepping up, and giving what they can in moments like this.**

name: Jim Jordan
subject: No one should ever accuse you of being a Democrat
body:
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Peter!

| Peter,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._

name: Ken Martin
subject: I flew across the country for this…
body:
A note from the ground in Arizona
---
Derek — it’s Ken Martin. I was just on the ground in Phoenix, Arizona to register new Democratic voters with our When We Count Fellows. [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2026-mid-month?refcode=em_20260514_7133_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7133_22930333_6AhPD1&akid=7133%2E22930333%2E6AhPD1) I flew across the country to be in person with our Fellows because **I truly believe every single conversation we have (and every voter we register) between now and November matters.** That’s the whole reason why we launched When We Count: To make sure that potential voters in battleground states hear from passionate young Democrats in their own communities. **To close the gap in voter registration with _real_ connections. To organize everywhere so we can win anywhere.** Watching our team at work was genuinely inspiring: Fellows are meeting young people where they already are using third spaces — cafes, concerts, rideshares, thrift stores — you name it. We’re also organizing online through Instagram, Snapchat, Discord, and group chats because the bottom line is: **If young people are there,_so are our Fellows.**_ **Derek, right now we have 40 Fellows on the ground in Arizona. By June, we’ll have 75. And we’re not stopping there — we’re expanding to more battleground states soon.** [**The fact is that this work is not easy. As you can imagine, it’s expensive to scale up the number of Fellows we’ve got on the ground and make sure they have what they need to be successful. So I’m asking: Please chip in $7 today to help us expand our organizing work and win this November.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2026-mid-month?refcode=em_20260514_7133_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7133_22930333_6AhPD1&akid=7133%2E22930333%2E6AhPD1) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2026-mid-month?express_lane=true&amount=7&refcode=em_20260514_7133_fr&refcode2=7133_22930333_6AhPD1&akid=7133%2E22930333%2E6AhPD1)**
